title: Frames until the timer ends
prompt: A timer has time_left seconds to go and every frame lasts delta seconds. Return how many whole frames fit into the time left.
signature: func solve(time_left: float, delta: float) -> int:
starter:
func solve(time_left: float, delta: float) -> int:
	return 0
hint: Divide, then turn the result into a whole number with int(), which drops the decimals.
solution:
func solve(time_left: float, delta: float) -> int:
	return int(time_left / delta)
